strings: r_c0 is doing a general den check on m_c when {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} {VERB/r_c0/notice/notices} that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} breathing is coming particularly harshly.

m_c has been struggling to breathe. Some of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates are worried about it being whitecough, but it seems to be just a bit of panic.
